## Safety And Privacy Checklist

- [ ] No API keys, bot tokens, auth headers, `.env` contents, local logs, or private chat data are included.
- [ ] User-facing errors and logs do not reveal secrets.
- [ ] External content is treated as untrusted.
- [ ] Public/external/destructive actions remain permission-gated.
- [ ] Docs are updated for config or behavior changes.
